# Settings

<!-- Generated by backend/scripts/settings_reference.py from api/settings.py. Do not edit:
     change the script (or the setting) and run it again. A test fails when this is stale. -->

Every setting is an environment variable starting with `PA_`. Put them in `.env` at the top
of the repository (laptop, `just run`, the systemd service) or in `deploy/server.env` (Docker).
A variable given to the process directly wins over the file. There is no other settings file.
Leave a setting out to get its default; restart the app after a change.

Write lists (`PA_ALLOWED_HOSTS`) comma-separated, without quotes, brackets or spaces.

| Area | Variable | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| General | `PA_DATA_ROOT` | `~/PhotoAssistant/data` | The library folder: database, originals, thumbnails, logs. The only machine-specific path. |
| General | `PA_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | Address the server listens on. Keep it on 127.0.0.1 and let Tailscale forward to it (remote-access.md). |
| General | `PA_PORT` | `8420` | Port the server listens on. |
| General | `PA_MIN_FREE_GB` | `10` | An import pauses instead of leaving less than this free on the library disk; `just doctor` warns near it. |
| General | `PA_THUMB_EDGE` | `640` | Longest edge of a thumbnail, in pixels. |
| General | `PA_PREVIEW_EDGE` | `2048` | Longest edge of a preview (the big view), in pixels. |
| General | `PA_WORKER_ENABLED` | `true` | `false` starts the server without its background work: no job worker (previews, imports, ML, backups) and no periodic tasks. |
| General | `PA_WORKER_POLL_SECONDS` | `1` | How often an idle job worker looks for a new job. |
| General | `PA_VIPS_CONCURRENCY` | `2` | Threads libvips may use to render one image. |
| General | `PA_PREVIEW_WORKERS` | `0` | Previews rendered at the same time; `0` means two fewer than the processor's cores, at least 1. |
| General | `PA_LOG_LEVEL` | `INFO` | How much is logged: `DEBUG`, `INFO`, `WARNING` or `ERROR`. |
| General | `PA_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | `127.0.0.1,localhost` | Host names the server answers to; any other name is refused. Add the Tailscale name here (remote-access.md). |
| General | `PA_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | `127.0.0.1` | Addresses or networks of the https proxy in front of the server, comma-separated. Only these may say a request arrived over https and from which device. In Docker: the Docker networks (server.env.example). |
| General | `PA_WEB_DIR` | not set | Folder with the built web app, served at `/`. `just run`, the systemd unit and the Docker image set it; not set = API only. |
| General | `PA_TRASH_PURGE_EVERY_HOURS` | `6` | How often the server deletes photos that have been in the trash for 30 days. |
| General | `PA_SOURCE_RECHECK_POLL_SECONDS` | `300` | How often the server looks for folders whose automatic re-check is due. |
| General | `PA_ARGON2_TIME_COST` | `3` | Work factor of the PIN hash. Tests lower it; never lower it in use. |
| General | `PA_ARGON2_MEMORY_KIB` | `65536` | Memory used by one PIN hash, in KiB. Tests lower it; never lower it in use. |
| General | `PA_FACE_CLUSTER_EVERY_HOURS` | `24` | How often faces are regrouped into people. |
| General | `PA_TEST_MODE` | `false` | End-to-end tests only: adds `POST /__test/reset`, which wipes the library. Refused unless host and allowed hosts are loopback. Never set it on a real library. |
| Uploads, sources, AI | `PA_UPLOAD_MAX_MB` | `200` | Largest single uploaded file, in MB; the upload is cut off as soon as it passes. |
| Uploads, sources, AI | `PA_UPLOAD_MAX_FILES` | `500` | Most files in one upload request. |
| Uploads, sources, AI | `PA_RCLONE_BINARY` | `rclone` | The rclone program (name on the PATH, or a full path). |
| Uploads, sources, AI | `PA_RCLONE_CONFIG` | not set | rclone's config file, where the cloud sign-ins live; not set = rclone's own default, `~/.config/rclone/rclone.conf`. |
| Uploads, sources, AI | `PA_RCLONE_TPSLIMIT` | `4` | Most requests per second to a cloud source (MEGA blocks accounts that hammer it); `0` = no limit. |
| Uploads, sources, AI | `PA_RCLONE_TRANSFERS` | `2` | Files rclone downloads at the same time. |
| Uploads, sources, AI | `PA_RCLONE_CHECKERS` | `4` | Files rclone compares at the same time. |
| Uploads, sources, AI | `PA_RCLONE_TIMEOUT_HOURS` | `6` | A pull from a cloud source is stopped after this long; the next run continues. |
| Uploads, sources, AI | `PA_PROTON_DRIVE_BINARY` | `proton-drive` | Proton's own `proton-drive` program (also looked for in `~/.local/bin`). |
| Uploads, sources, AI | `PA_AI_PROVIDER` | `none` | `none`, or `ollama` to switch the optional AI features on. |
| Uploads, sources, AI | `PA_OLLAMA_BASE_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:11434` | Where Ollama runs: the only address AI requests are sent to. |
| Uploads, sources, AI | `PA_OLLAMA_CAPTION_MODEL` | not set | Ollama model that describes photos; not set = no captions. |
| Uploads, sources, AI | `PA_OLLAMA_PLAN_MODEL` | not set | Ollama model that proposes albums; not set = no album proposals. |
| Uploads, sources, AI | `PA_OLLAMA_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `120` | How long to wait for one Ollama answer. |
| Local ML | `PA_ML_ENABLED` | `true` | `false`: no photo is queued for search, faces or tags. |
| Local ML | `PA_ML_MODELS_DIR` | not set | Folder with the model files (`just models` fills it); not set = `<data root>/models`. |
| Local ML | `PA_ML_PROVIDER` | `auto` | Where models run: `auto` (graphics card if this onnxruntime supports it, else processor), `cpu`, or `cuda` (an error if it is missing). |
| Local ML | `PA_ML_CLIP_MODEL` | `ViT-B-32__openai` | The search model, by its Immich name on Hugging Face. `XLM-Roberta-Large-Vit-B-32` understands French and English queries. |
| Local ML | `PA_ML_CLIP_BATCH_SIZE` | `16` | Photos handed to the search model at once (1 to 256). |
| Local ML | `PA_ML_FACE_MODEL` | `buffalo_l` | Face model: `buffalo_l` (more accurate, non-commercial licence) or `yunet_sface`. |
| Local ML | `PA_ML_FACE_DET_SIZE` | `640` | Image size the face detector works at, in pixels (160 to 1920). |
| Local ML | `PA_ML_FACE_MIN_SCORE` | not set | How sure the detector must be that something is a face (0 to 1); not set = 0.7 for buffalo_l, 0.8 for yunet_sface. |
| Local ML | `PA_ML_FACE_MAX_DISTANCE` | not set | How different two faces may be and still count as one person; not set = 0.5 for buffalo_l, 0.6 for yunet_sface. |
| Local ML | `PA_ML_FACE_MIN_FACES` | `3` | Faces needed before a new person is suggested. |
| Local ML | `PA_ML_TAG_MARGIN` | `0.03` | How clearly a tag must beat the neutral baseline: higher = fewer, surer tags. |
| Local ML | `PA_ML_TAG_MAX_TAGS` | `3` | Most automatic tags per photo. |
| Local ML | `PA_ML_SEARCH_MIN_SCORE` | not set | Search hits scoring below this are dropped; not set = keep all. |
| Backups | `PA_BACKUP_ENABLED` | `true` | `false` stops scheduled backups from running inside the server (`just backup run` still works). |
| Backups | `PA_BACKUP_POLL_SECONDS` | `60` | How often the server checks whether a backup is due. |
| Backups | `PA_BACKUP_RESTORE_SAMPLE` | `20` | Photos restored and compared in one restore test. |
| Backups | `PA_BACKUP_SCRATCH_DIR` | not set | Where a restore test unpacks its sample; not set = the system temp folder. Must be outside the library. |
| Backups | `PA_BACKUP_KEY_DIR` | not set | Where the app keeps the backup encryption keys it makes; not set = `~/.config/photo-assistant/backup-keys`. Must be outside the library. |
| Backups | `PA_RESTIC_BINARY` | `restic` | The restic program (name on the PATH, or a full path). |
| Backups | `PA_RESTIC_CACHE_DIR` | not set | restic's cache folder; not set = restic's own default, `~/.cache/restic`. |

## Other `PA_` names you may meet

These are not read by the app's settings.

| Variable | Read by | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `PA_HOST_DATA_ROOT`, `PA_HOST_CONFIG`, `PA_HOST_SECRETS`, `PA_HOST_BACKUP_DISK` | `deploy/compose.yml` | Folders on the server that Docker mounts into the container (move-to-server.md). |
| `PA_API` | the web dev server (`web/vite.config.ts`) | Which API `pnpm dev` talks to; default `http://127.0.0.1:8420`. |
| `PA_REQUIRE_TOOLS` | the backend tests | `1` makes a test that would be skipped for a missing tool (exiftool, vips, restic, rclone) fail instead. Set in the CI file. |
| `PA_MODELS_DIR` | the backend tests | Folder with the real model files, for `pytest -m models`. |
| `PA_UPDATE_GOLDENS` | the print tests | `1` rewrites the reference page images. |
